text: For solar, compare the same twenty-foot-wide dome three ways.
Cells on the top half with a metal skirt below.
Or cells over the whole shell.
The one-sided version gives rotation the clearest purpose: turn the useful face toward the sun.
Whole-shell coverage means some cells face many different directions, so panel area alone cannot tell you the day's energy output.
The metal skirt is also a possible rain-catching surface.
The choice is about how you want to use the shell.
